name: hero-video-dialog
title: Hero Video Dialog
description: A click-to-play video card: the round play button on the thumbnail opens a blurred full-screen dialog holding the embedded video, springing in from a chosen side.
use: A landing page wants a promo video kept one click away without leaving the page.
avoid: Slow connections: the dialog opens onto a blank, unlabelled iframe while the video loads.
a11y: Opens and closes by keyboard, but focus is not trapped in the dialog or returned to the thumbnail, and there is no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded video thumbnail on a black stage, a dark dashboard screenshot under a blue-to-purple gradient with a white headline. A white circular play button wrapped in a frosted halo sits centred on it.
behaves: Clicking the thumbnail opens a full-screen blurred backdrop with the video in a rounded white-bordered frame that springs in. The dialog closes on its X, the Escape key, or a click outside.
customise: Video URL, thumbnail URL, alt text and one of eight entry animations are props; overlay tint and close-button styling live in the source.
weight: light: One image, a button and an iframe that only mounts while the dialog is open.
